reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333! This is the fix #199 proposed: no shutdown hook, so teams go away only on an explicit `TeamDelete`. We ran the new test against `main`'s `init.ts` and it fails there (the team directory is gone); with your change it passes, also in random order with the swarm and teams tests.

We pushed a merge of `main` and a small commit on top: your CHANGELOG entry had landed in the 0.6.1 section, so it now sits under `[Unreleased]` with a thanks line; we removed the added comments (we keep new code comment-free); and we fixed two existing comments in `teamHelpers.ts` and `state.ts` that said teams are cleaned up on exit.

We left `cleanupSessionTeams` and the session tracking in place, as you did: what to do with teams nobody deletes is the separate decision #199 leaves open. Approving and merging. Thanks again!
